Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class AgentSerializer

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.AgentSerializer
  • public class AgentSerializer
extends Object
    Serializes and deserializes KDC Agent and Reply objects for transmission between communication endpoints.

    This serializer manages KDC packet creation and processing, object serialization, compression, encryption, CRC checking, class whitelisting, protocol versioning, and send and receive buffer limits.

    Serialization behavior is initially configured from Parameters. Selected settings, including compression, encryption, CRC checking, and serialization format, may be changed through this serializer.

    When changing serialization settings at runtime, communicating endpoints must use compatible settings to successfully exchange data.

    The KDC wire format is subject to change between versions. Serialized agent or reply bytes should not be treated as a persistent storage format and are not guaranteed to be compatible with subsequent versions of KDC or its serialization implementation.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed

    • Constructor Detail

      • AgentSerializer

        public AgentSerializer​(Parameters parameters)
        Constructs an agent serializer using the specified KDC configuration.

        The supplied parameters determine the protocol version, send and receive buffer limits, and initial class whitelist used by this serializer.

        Parameters:
        parameters - the KDC parameters used to configure this serializer
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if parameters is null

    • Method Detail

      • addToWhiteList

        public void addToWhiteList​(String className)
        Adds a class or package name to the whitelist of classes permitted during deserialization.

        Classes that may be instantiated as part of a received agent's object graph must be permitted by the serializer's whitelist.

        To whitelist a package, specify the fully qualified package name ending with a period (.).

        Parameters:
        className - the fully qualified class name or package name to add to the whitelist
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if className is null or blank

      • removeFromWhitelist

        public void removeFromWhitelist​(String className)
        Removes a class or package name from the whitelist of classes permitted during deserialization.

        When removing a package, specify the fully qualified package name ending with a period (.), matching the entry used when the package was added to the whitelist.

        Parameters:
        className - the fully qualified class name or package name to remove from the whitelist
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if className is null or blank

      • setEncryptionKey

        public void setEncryptionKey​(com.kristensoft.ko.EncryptionKey encryptionKey)
        Sets the encryption key used by this serializer.

        Setting a non-null encryption key enables encryption. Setting the encryption key to null disables encryption.

        Communicating endpoints must use compatible encryption settings and keys to successfully exchange encrypted data.

        Parameters:
        encryptionKey - the encryption key to use, or null to disable encryption

      • setCompressed

        public void setCompressed​(boolean compressed)
        Enables or disables compression for this serializer.

        When enabled, serialized data is compressed before transmission. When disabled, serialized data is transmitted without compression.

        Communicating endpoints must use compatible compression settings to successfully exchange data.

        Parameters:
        compressed - true to enable compression; false to disable compression

      • isCrcCheck

        public boolean isCrcCheck()
        Determines whether CRC checking is enabled for this serializer.
        Returns:
        true if CRC checking is enabled; false otherwise

      • setCrcCheck

        public void setCrcCheck​(boolean crcCheck)
        Enables or disables CRC checking for serialized packets.

        When enabled, a CRC value is included with serialized packets and may be used to detect data corruption during transmission. CRC checking is disabled by default.

        Parameters:
        crcCheck - true to enable CRC checking; false to disable CRC checking

      • serialize

        public byte[] serialize​(Agent agent)
                 throws IOException,
                        KristenCommsException
        Serializes the specified agent into a KDC packet for transmission.

        The agent is serialized according to the current serialization, compression, encryption, CRC, and protocol version settings of this serializer.

        Parameters:
        agent - the agent to serialize
        Returns:
        the serialized KDC packet
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if agent is null
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs while creating the packet
        KristenCommsException - if the agent cannot be serialized into a valid KDC packet

      • deserialize

        public Agent deserialize​(byte[] bytes,
                         int offset,
                         int length)
                  throws KristenCommsException,
                         com.kristensoft.ko.KristenObjectsException,
                         IOException,
                         ClassNotFoundException
        Deserializes a KDC packet contained within the specified portion of a byte array into an agent.

        The packet is validated according to the configured protocol version and receive buffer limit. The packet's class must be permitted for deserialization and must be assignable to Agent. Compression and encryption settings must be compatible with those of this serializer.

        Parameters:
        bytes - the byte array containing the serialized KDC packet
        offset - the starting offset of the packet within the byte array
        length - the number of bytes to deserialize
        Returns:
        the deserialized agent
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if bytes is null
        KristenCommsException - if the packet is invalid, exceeds the receive buffer limit, contains an invalid agent type, or is incompatible with the serializer configuration
        com.kristensoft.ko.KristenObjectsException - if object deserialization fails
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the packet
        ClassNotFoundException - if the agent class cannot be found

      • deserialize

        public Agent deserialize​(byte[] data)
                  throws IOException,
                         ClassNotFoundException,
                         com.kristensoft.ko.KristenObjectsException,
                         KristenCommsException
        Deserializes a KDC packet contained in the specified byte array into an agent.

        This method deserializes the entire byte array.

        Parameters:
        data - the byte array containing the serialized KDC packet
        Returns:
        the deserialized agent
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if data is null
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the packet
        ClassNotFoundException - if the agent class cannot be found
        com.kristensoft.ko.KristenObjectsException - if object deserialization fails
        KristenCommsException - if the packet is invalid or cannot be deserialized using the current serializer configuration

      • deserializeReply

        public Reply deserializeReply​(byte[] bytes,
                              Parameters parameters)
                       throws ClassNotFoundException,
                              IOException,
                              com.kristensoft.ko.KristenObjectsException,
                              KristenCommsException
        Deserializes a KDC packet into a reply.

        The packet's class must be permitted for deserialization and must be assignable to Reply. The protocol version specified by the supplied parameters is used to determine the packet format.

        Parameters:
        bytes - the byte array containing the serialized KDC reply packet
        parameters - the KDC parameters containing the protocol version to use
        Returns:
        the deserialized reply
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if bytes or parameters is null
        ClassNotFoundException - if the reply class cannot be found
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the packet
        com.kristensoft.ko.KristenObjectsException - if object deserialization fails
        KristenCommsException - if the packet is invalid, does not contain a reply, or cannot be deserialized
